title: 電気応用
subtitle: Electric Power Applications
educationalGoal: (1) learn an overview of motor applications. (2) learn concept of the electrochemistry. (3) learn basis of the electrical machining, the lighting and the electrical heating. (4) learn basis of the air conditioning system and the freezer machine. (5) learn concept of the distributed power supply and the smart grid.
advice: This is a basic course of electric power applications. We will cover the following materials: 1. Motor applications 1-1 Electric power control / 1-2 Industrial applications / 1-3 Operation control 2. Electrochemistry 2-1 Electrolysis / 2-2 Battery (Primary battery, Secondary battery, Fuel cell) / 2-3 Corrosion 3. Electrical machining 3-1 Electric discharge / 3-2 Electric discharge machining and electron beam 4. Electrical heating 4-1 Basis of electrical heating / 4-2 Kinds of electrical heating 5. Lighting 5-1 Basis of lighting / 5-2 Lighting design / 5-3 Light sources 6. Air conditioning system and freezer machine 6-1 Freezing cycle / 6-2 Freezer machine / 6-3 Air conditioning system / 6-4 Heat pump 7. Other electric power applications 7-1 distributed power supply and smart grid / 7-2 Superconductor applications
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Electrical Machinery I and II,High-Voltage Pulsed Power Engineering, Power Electronics, Feedback Control, and Energy Devices.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain industrial applications of the electric motor.
Be able to explain overview of electrochemistry and basic characteristics of batteries.
Be able to explain characteristics of the electrical machining and the electrical heating.
Be able to explain characteristics of the lighting design and the light sources.
Be able to explain characteristics of the air conditioning system and freezer machine
Be able to explain overview of new power grid systems such as the smart grid and the superconducting power trans
